comment: Engagement Hub, Feature 2. This file exists for ONE reason: to make the
public booking link /book/<slug> work on a static export.
next.config.js sets output: 'export' (it is what Capacitor bundles into
the APK), so Next can only emit routes it can enumerate at build time. A
[slug] segment needs generateStaticParams, and booking slugs are created
by users after the build, so the route is a single static page that reads
the slug from the URL instead (src/app/book/page.tsx).
This rewrite is what lets that page answer /book/intro-call/ rather than
only /book/?slug=intro-call. Both forms work; this one is the link people
actually paste into an email. Without this file the query form still
works, so a deployment on another host degrades rather than breaking.
Deliberately narrow: only /book/* is rewritten. A catch-all would swallow
